Subject: Recap + next steps from today's call - decision criteria (latency, cost, deployment, SLA)

Hi Amit / Elena,

Thanks for taking the time today - great conversation. As promised, a quick recap of the decision criteria and explicit next steps so we can keep momentum. Please let me know if I mischaracterized anything.

High-level requirements you shared:
- Latency targets: p95 for chat/generation at ~512 tokens: target < 200 ms (would prefer <150 ms if possible); embeddings p95 target < 100 ms.
- Cost sensitivity: working target is to be < $0.001 per token equivalent for inference in your baseline workload; total monthly spend target to stay within the pilot budget for Q3.
- Deployment mode: leaning toward Private (VPC) so data stays in Finova-managed VPC; Dedicated reserved capacity acceptable if Private not immediately available.
- SLA/availability: commercial SLA requirement of 99.9% uptime across production endpoints and a written incident escalation path.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data retention controls, and support for customer-managed KMS. Procurement will request the security questionnaire and standard DPA.
- Economic buyer: Elena - procurement/legal looped in for contract redlines.

Attachments: I attached a quick draft decision-criteria doc from our side (initial version) for your review.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Amit: confirm list of stakeholders (economic buyer + procurement contact) and any additional hard constraints (by EOD Wed).
- Marissa: share updated decision-criteria doc and example SLA language once we confirm targets (by end of week).
- Vivek/Legal: stand by for procurement contact and we will provide SOC2 evidence and security questionnaire responses.

Thanks again - happy to jump on a short follow-up if that helps align stakeholders.

Best,

Thanks Marissa - that looks right. Couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Stakeholders / economic buyer
- Primary economic buyer: Elena Suarez (me) - will own budget sign-off.
- Technical owners: Amit Shah (ML infra) and Ravi Menon (SRE) - both should be included on technical evaluations.

2) Procurement/contact
- Procurement inbox: procurement@finova.com (please include in future communications). Our procurement lead is Sheila Park; I can loop her if needed.

3) Latency/cost specifics
- For conversational latency we are targeting p95 < 150 ms at 512 tokens for the pilot (lower is better, but 150 ms is a gating requirement).
- Embeddings must return p95 < 50 ms for the top-10k queries use case.
- Cost target: we are aiming for <$0.0008/token equivalent averaged over projected usage for the pilot. If we can show predictable batching/cost controls that will help.

4) Deployment preference
- Prefer Private (VPC) deployment in our AWS account. If timelines for Private are longer, a Dedicated reserved pool in Redwood in our region (us-west-2) is acceptable as a temporary option.

5) SLA / legal
- 99.9% production SLA is the requirement. Also need a named RTO/RPO for incident response and a 24x7 escalation path.

Next asks for Redwood:
- Can you confirm whether the latency numbers above are achievable for your recommended model + deployment modes?
- Please share SOC 2 Type II evidence and a sample SLA + incident escalation doc we can include with procurement.

Happy to take a quick read of your updated decision criteria when ready.

Best,
Amit
Head of ML Infrastructure | Finova
amit.shah@finova.com
